_help: Edit the text between the quotes on the right of each colon. Keep every quote, comma and bracket. Lines starting with _help are notes and never appear on the website. A link left empty ("") shows the button but does nothing until you paste the real link.

meta.title: Kommz Hub | Creative communications agency, Kigali
meta.description: Kommz Hub is a creative communications agency in Kigali, Rwanda. Strategy, branding, digital marketing, creative production, PR and campaigns.

hero._help: video = the main video file. Use MP4 (H.264): it plays on every browser and phone. videoFallback = a second file the browser tries if the first is missing or cannot play. poster = picture shown while the video loads. overlay = how much to darken the video behind the text: 0 means fully visible, 0.4 means 40% darker. The video always plays muted on its own; soundButton shows a button visitors can use to turn sound on.
paragraphs: We are Kommz Hub, a creative communications agency based in Kigali, Rwanda.
We help brands and organisations find their voice, tell stories worth sharing, and build meaningful connections with the people who matter to them.
Through strategy, creativity, and thoughtful execution, we turn ideas into communication that makes an impact.

clientLogos._help: Client logos, shown as logos only (no names) in the sliding band under the opening video. To add a real logo, save the file in assets/img/clients/ with the file name written below (for example kayko.png). It appears automatically: no code to change. PNG with a transparent background or SVG looks best; .png, .svg, .jpg and .webp all work. Until a file is there, the Kommz Hub mark is shown in its place. To add another client, copy one line, change the name and file name, and save the logo with that file name. name is only read aloud by screen readers. monochrome: true shows every logo in one colour so they match; set false to show the logos' own colours.

services._help: The six services appear in one card. Clicking a service opens its details; only one is open at a time. Each button has a link, and preselect fills the 'What can we help you with?' box in the contact form (it must match one of the contact form options exactly, or be empty). image can also be a short video ending in .mp4.
heading: Different expertise.
One connected approach.
intro: Good communication rarely happens in isolation.
A strong campaign needs a clear strategy. A compelling story needs the right creative execution. And great content needs a plan to reach the people it was made for.
We bring these disciplines together to help our clients communicate more effectively.

items.title: Communication Strategy
items.headline: Say the right thing, to the right people.
text: Before deciding what to communicate, we help you understand why it matters and who needs to hear it.
We work with brands and organisations to develop communication strategies that align their objectives, messages, audiences, and channels.

items.title: Brand Strategy & Positioning
items.headline: Know who you are. Make sure everyone else does too.
text: A strong brand is more than a logo or a colour palette. It’s what people understand, experience, and remember about your business.
We help brands define their identity, communicate their value, and build a consistent presence across every touchpoint.

items.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media
items.headline: More than posts. A presence with purpose.
text: Being visible online is important. But visibility alone isn’t enough.
We help businesses build meaningful digital connections through strategic content, thoughtful storytelling, and campaigns designed around clear objectives.
From developing a content strategy to managing day-to-day communication, we help brands show up consistently and communicate effectively.

items.title: Creative Production
items.headline: Stories people can see, hear, and feel.
text: Some stories are best told through a photograph. Others need a film, a conversation, or a carefully designed visual.
We bring ideas to life through creative production that captures attention while staying true to the message.
Whether it’s a commercial, documentary, brand campaign, or social media video, we focus on creating work that people connect with.

items.title: Public Relations & Media Relations
items.headline: The right story deserves the right audience.
text: How an organisation communicates with the public matters.
We help businesses and institutions communicate their stories, engage with the media, and build stronger relationships with the audiences and stakeholders who influence their reputation.

items.title: Campaigns & Creative Experiences
items.headline: Ideas that move beyond the brief.
text: Some messages need more than a single post or video.
We develop integrated campaigns that bring strategy, creativity, content, and audience engagement together around a shared objective.
From campaign concepts to execution, we help brands create experiences that people notice and remember.

wordmarkBand._help: rows = how many sliding Kommz Hub lines are shown (1 to 14). Their size is set by --band-size in assets/css/kommzhub.css.

work._help: Two cards: video and photo. VIDEO: vimeoUrl is the Vimeo showcase or video link; it opens in a player on the page, with a 'Watch on Vimeo' button underneath. PHOTO: put your photos in assets/img/ named gallery1.jpg, gallery2.jpg ... up to gallery20.jpg (galleryCount). They appear in the gallery automatically, in number order; missing numbers are skipped, and .jpg, .JPG, .jpeg, .png and .webp all work. While no gallery photos exist yet, fallbackImages are shown instead; empty that list ([]) once your gallery photos are in. cover = the card picture; leave the photo card's cover empty to use the first gallery photo.

team._help: All team members, founder first, appear in one sliding row of portraits. Clicking a portrait opens that person's full bio. bio can have several paragraphs. Put each photo in assets/img/ with the file name written in photo; without a photo, the person's initials are shown. To add someone, copy one member block.
team.heading: Meet the people behind the ideas.
intro: Behind every campaign, photograph, strategy, and production is a team of people who care about getting the details right.
At Kommz Hub, we bring together different perspectives and creative skills, working collaboratively to deliver communication that serves our clients.
We believe great work comes from people who are curious, thoughtful, and willing to challenge ideas until they become better.

founder.name: Davis Higiro
bio: Davis Higiro is a communications professional and multimedia storyteller with experience spanning journalism, digital media, public relations, and creative production.
His work has involved developing stories, managing digital communication, producing multimedia content, and working with organisations to communicate their ideas to diverse audiences.
He founded Kommz Hub to bring together communication strategy and creative execution, helping brands approach storytelling with greater clarity and purpose.

members.name: Junior Nkuba Igiraneza
bio: Junior brings brands to life through intentional storytelling, thoughtful communication, and creative strategy. From shaping brand positioning and developing content strategies to directing creative concepts and overseeing execution, he transforms ideas into meaningful experiences that connect with audiences.
Working at the intersection of strategy, creativity, and storytelling, Junior ensures every brand has not just something to say, but a compelling way to say it.

members.name: Brian Sheja
bio: Brian brings stories to life through his lens, transforming creative ideas into compelling visual content. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for visual storytelling, he captures moments that communicate, connect, and leave a lasting impression.
From camera work and composition to video production, Brian focuses on making every frame count, ensuring each project reflects the brand’s identity and message.

members.name: Prince Blaise Kamanzi
bio: With over 10 years of experience in film production, digital content, and brand storytelling across Africa and Europe, Prince brings a wealth of creative expertise to Kommz Hub.

As a Creative Director and Multimedia Storyteller, he combines filmmaking, creative direction, and visual storytelling to develop compelling narratives that connect audiences, amplify brands, and drive social impact.
His approach goes beyond creating beautiful visuals, focusing on stories that spark emotions, inspire action, and leave a lasting impression.

booking._help: email = where enquiries are delivered.
